duas.title: The Greatest Du'ā of Tawheed:
duas.english: There is no god worthy of worship except Allāh.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ said this is the best remembrance. (Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī 3435)

duas.title: Du'ā for Firmness in Faith:
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.english: O Changer of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
duas.reference: Reported by Umm Salamah, the Prophet ﷺ recited this often. (Jāmi' at-Tirmidhī 3522 - Ṣaḥīḥ)

duas.title: Du'ā for Guidance to Truth:
duas.arabic: اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
duas.english: Guide me to the truth in matters where people differ.
duas.reference: The Prophet ﷺ taught this du'ā. (Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 770)

duas.english: O Allah, grant me faith that translates into action.
Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْنِي مَا يَرْتَفِعُ بِهِ إِيمَانِي
duas.english: O Allah, teach me what raises my belief.
O Allah, make me among those who establish the prayer.
My Lord, let my fast be a thank-you to You.
O Allah, accept charity from us.
O Allah, open for me the doors of Your guidance.
My Lord, increase me in understanding.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي الْقُرْآنَ رَحْمَةً وَنُورًا
duas.english: O Allah, make the Quran a mercy and light for me.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad.
O Allah, teach me his Sunnah.
O Allah, revive my heart with his guidance.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ خُشُوعًا
duas.english: O Allah, grant me focus in prayer.
My Lord, help me perform it.
O Allah, make it a bond between me and You.
Glory be to Allah.
All praise is due to Allah.
Allah is the Greatest.
O Allah, purify my heart.
My Lord, make my heart turn to You.
O Allah, make Your remembrance a light for me.
O Allah, beautify me with good manners.
My Lord, save me from the anger of my chest.
O Allah, make my speech gentle.
O Allah, bless my provision.
My Lord, rescue me from heedlessness.
O Allah, make me one who holds to halal.
My Lord, rectify my household.
O Allah, bring hearts together.
My Lord, make my offspring among the righteous.
O Allah, unite us in love.
My Lord, reform my community.
O Allah, move me from isolation into service.
My Lord, I ask You for light for my path.
O Allah, strengthen our chests for steadiness.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي قَلْبًا سَلِيمًا لِمَا بَعْدَ
duas.english: My Lord, grant me a sound heart for what comes next.
O Allah, make my grave a garden.
My Lord, admit me into Paradise with the righteous.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى الذِّكْرِ وَالْعَمَلِ الْجَيِّدِ حَتَّى الْمَوْتِ
duas.english: O Allah, help me remember You and do good deeds until death.
O Allah, make me among the companions of Paradise.
My Lord, make my heart fear the Fire.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ أَشْجَارِ الْجَنَّةِ ظِلًّا
duas.english: O Allah, grant me shade from the trees of Paradise.
